csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wake County Renovations Project
csv_scope_of_work: Architectural and engineering firms to provide design services for involving modification and renovation to County Buildings. The project types will vary in type and scale, ranging from work requiring informal bids (construction cost less than $500,000) to scope that dictates formal range bidding (construction cost exceeding $500,000). Example locations could include the Waverly F. Akins Wake County Office Building, Justice Center and Public Safety Center in addition to various Public Safety facilities, Human Services, Library system and Parks buildings, historic buildings and other County department sites. All facilities house a variety of functions and include administrative offices, meeting areas, conference rooms, utility and storage spaces, judicial and detention spaces, public areas and other related support functions that serve the community.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering

short_description: Design services for varied renovation and modification projects across multiple Wake County buildings.
project_location: Raleigh, Wake County, North Carolina, USA
project_scope: On-call architectural and engineering design services for modifications and renovations to multiple county buildings and sites. Project types vary in type and scale, from informal-bid works with construction cost below 500000 USD to formally bid projects exceeding 500000 USD. Example facilities include the Waverly F. services: Architectural and engineering design services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a renovation and refurbishment framework for general county buildings, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Includes many administrative and routine public buildings rather than structurally ambitious or iconic projects.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, tower, or special structural scope is identified.
- Multi-disciplinary A/E scope includes civil engineering, but no explicit structural design challenge or innovative construction component is described.
- Construction cost range is broad, but individual projects may be small and technically ordinary.
construction_cost_explanation: No single project construction cost is stated; the notice describes multiple task-based renovation projects ranging from 100000 USD to 8000000 USD total construction cost per project/task. Because this is an on-call multi-project procurement, no realistic single construction cost can be assigned.
fee_explanation: No design fee is stated in the tender documents. The procurement appears to be an on-call A/E services contract with up to 2 to 4 contracts awarded and a 72-month duration, but without enough information to derive a reliable sbp fee estimate.
